title: Servers.com
description: Servers.com Enterprise Bare Metal state from prometheus-serverscom-exporter.

panels.title: Uplinks disaggregated
panels.description: Redundant uplinks whose ports were split with the disaggregated_*_ports feature.

panels.title: Servers
panels.description: One row per server. Uplinks: aggregated = redundant uplink with ports in a LAG; disaggregated = redundant uplink split with the disaggregated_*_ports feature; single link = no redundancy.

targets.expr: max by (host_id, title, location, rack, configuration, private_ipv4, public_ipv4, oob_ipv4) (serverscom_host_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack"})
max by (host_id) (serverscom_host_uplink_redundant{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", uplink="public"} + serverscom_host_uplink_aggregated{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", uplink="public"})
max by (host_id) (serverscom_host_uplink_redundant{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", uplink="private"} + serverscom_host_uplink_aggregated{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", uplink="private"})

properties.value: Sum of drive_model.capacity as reported by the API (most likely GB).

panels.title: OOB
panels.description: OOB address and the status of the oob_public_access feature (public access to the OOB interface).

targets.expr: max by (host_id, title, location, rack, oob_ipv4) (serverscom_host_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack"})

serverscom_host_uplink_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack"} * on (host_id, uplink) group_left () (serverscom_host_uplink_redundant{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack"} + serverscom_host_uplink_aggregated{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack"})

panels.title: L2 segments
panels.description: Segments with at least one member in the selected locations and racks.

targets.expr: serverscom_l2_segment_info * on (segment_id) group_left () count by (segment_id) (serverscom_l2_segment_member_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack"})

(serverscom_host_drive_slot_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack"} * on (host_id, position) group_left () serverscom_host_drive_capacity{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack"}) or (serverscom_host_drive_slot_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", populated="false"} * 0)

properties.value: drive_model.capacity as reported by the API (most likely GB); 0 for empty slots.

panels.title: Data age by resource
panels.description: Time since the last successful refresh. Compare with the refresh intervals of the exporter.

panels.title: API rate limit (account-wide)
panels.description: X-RateLimit-* headers of API responses; the limit is shared by all API users of the account.

panels.title: API requests per hour by endpoint
